'''Bak''' was the airless, rocky first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was covered with rivers of [[Magma/Legends|lava]] and nearly molten rock.<ref name="TEA" />
